# use-geometry

RustUse geometry utilities and facade set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-geometry/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-geometry/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-geometry/

- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt
